s.note: Logan's quiet life working as a lumberjack in Canada
s.how: Cut 1kg potatoes into thick chips and fry twice until crisp. Melt 30g butter, stir in 2 tbsp flour, then whisk in 500ml beef stock and simmer until thick. Pile chips into bowls, scatter with torn mozzarella and pour over the hot gravy.

s.note: the logging camp in the Rockies
s.how: Cut 8 rashers of bacon in half. Wrap each half around a pitted medjool date and secure with a toothpick. Lay on a lined tray and bake at 200C for 15 minutes, turning once, until the bacon is crisp and the dates are sticky.

m.note: the elderly farm couple who take Logan in
m.how: Whisk 250g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 2 eggs and 375ml buttermilk into a batter and cook pancakes in butter. Fry 8 rashers of bacon and 4 eggs. Pile it all on one big plate and drown it in maple syrup.

w.how: Blind bake a shortcrust case. Whisk 250ml maple syrup with 3 eggs and 200ml cream until smooth. Pour into the case and bake at 170C for 40 minutes until just set with a slight wobble. Cool completely before slicing.

d.note: the Canadian Rockies where Logan lives with Kayla
d.how: Make 2 drinks at a time. Add 120ml Canadian whisky, 60ml lemon juice, 40ml maple syrup and 1 egg white to a shaker without ice and shake hard for 15 seconds. Add a big handful of ice and shake again until very cold. Strain into 2 rocks glasses over fresh ice and add 3 drops of bitters to the foam. Repeat for the other 2. For non-drinkers, use cold black tea instead of whisky.
